title: Are they lovers or friends? Evaluating LLMs’ Social Reasoning in English and Korean Dialogues
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating social relationship reasoning (e.g., distinguishing between friends, coworkers, or family members) and cultural/sociolinguistic nuances in LLMs. It does not contain an evaluation component specifically regarding religion, faith, or moral/ethical systems, though it notes that failures in reasoning can lead to social norm violations.
